note: Cambria is drawn with Caladea; LibreOffice spaces Caladea lines by its typo metrics (1.15 em), Layout by the Windows metrics Word uses (1.30 em). Calibri, Arial, Times and Courier lines match.

Line breaks and positions match LibreOffice. Since R3 (D-191) the Tamil text, which has no w:cs, takes the run's ordinary slot as Word does (font missing: LiPi Sans Tamil); LibreOffice uses the complex-script slot, so the drawing differs slightly (pixels 11.7%). Text differs only because Chuvadi.Pdf extracts LibreOffice's Tamil text wrongly (vowel signs repeated or moved); poppler extracts the same reference exactly as Layout writes it. Reported to the Pdf chat.

Since R3 (D-191) the Tamil text, which has no w:cs, takes the ordinary size (10 pt), not szCs (12 pt), as Word does: 3 pages. LibreOffice uses the complex-script slot (12 pt, 4 pages). Word 2021 draws it in Vijaya at 10 pt on 2 pages (docs/DIFFERENCES.md L-4). Text differs also because Chuvadi.Pdf misreads LibreOffice's Tamil text, as d03.
Space between paragraphs is the larger of space after and space before (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.
A paragraph holding only a page break keeps its mark on the old page (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.
Rows make room for their horizontal borders (fixed in Layout by this corpus). To confirm in Word.

Cell margins with nothing stated are the standard's 115 twips (5.75 pt; ECMA-376 17.4.34, 17.4.11; F3, docs/DIFFERENCES.md); LibreOffice uses 5.4 pt, so a few words in narrow cells wrap differently. Word uses 0 pt.
As d17: cell margins 5.75 pt (the standard) against LibreOffice's 5.4 pt, so several narrow cells wrap differently (F3, docs/DIFFERENCES.md).
After a nested table the cell's required empty paragraph takes no height, as Word does in every mode (measured, A7 D4; F2).
Newspaper columns: two columns with a separator, laid out as the file states them; the positions match Word 2021 within 0.1 pt (calibration of 3 Nov 2026).
A line holding only a picture is exactly the picture's height, as Word does (measured, A7 C1 to C3; F4).
Each tab draws the leader of its own stop (fixed in Layout by this corpus).
LibreOffice does not draw the dot leader of a positional tab; Layout does, as Word does.
A line may not run past the right margin: "nursing" (0.0008 pt too wide) starts the next line, as Word does (measured, A7 E1; F5).
The paragraph mark sizes only an empty line: the 8 pt lines are not raised by the 11 pt mark, as Word does (measured, A7 B1, B3, B4; F6).

Footnotes match LibreOffice on page 1 (positions within 0.6 pt, two-inch separator). Endnotes differ: LibreOffice puts them on a page of their own with its endnote page style; Layout, like Word, continues them after the text. To confirm in Word.

LibreOffice exports the markup (deleted text shown); Layout lays out the final view (changes accepted, comment balloons not drawn), as the Docs integration guide says. To confirm what Word prints by default (Print Markup).
Complex fields (REF, PAGEREF, SEQ) show their cached results; bookmark and field markers take no room.

Fill, outline, insets and text match. LibreOffice places the right-aligned box 8.45 pt further left (it keeps the 9 pt wrap distance inside the margin); Layout aligns the box edge to the margin, so lines beside it hold about one word more. To confirm in Word.

The floating table is placed as the file states it (200 pt from the margin, at the top of the next paragraph) with text on both sides, as in Word 2021 (calibration T1, the same settings, matches Word line for line). One word on the last row beside the table falls on the other side of the table in LibreOffice.
w:sym characters drawn in their font.
DejaVu Serif comes only from the document (LibreOffice and Layout both use the embedded font; it is in neither font set).
